CARD
**Still not ready**

This PR is meant to stop a scheduled message from being marked both "delivered" and "failed" when a later step errors after sending. After the squash, the PR now changes 123 files (+4994/-5409) instead of 2 files (+46/-11). Most of these changes are unrelated to scheduled messages, so the PR can't be reviewed as it stands.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ℹ️  | Since the feedback, 6 commits were squashed into 1, but the diff grew from 2 files to 123, including web, puppet, docs, and corporate files unrelated to this fix. This looks like a bad squash or merge of upstream changes. |
| ❌  | The diff must contain only the scheduled-message fix and its test. |
| ❌  | No linked issue or "Fixes: #N". The description says the PR is not from a filed issue, and the author has no merged PRs. |
| ⚠️  | Testing is partly done. The regression test was added, but the author did not run it locally and relied on CI. |
| ✅  | The description was rewritten and the self-review checklist is filled in. |

**Reviewer:** None yet. The PR is not ready for review.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and send the reply below. Close it if the author can't clean up the branch.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing! The PR now includes about 120 unrelated files, probably from the upstream merge, so please rebase the branch so the diff contains only your scheduled-message fix and its test. Also, please link an existing "help wanted" issue, or open one for this bug and wait for a maintainer to confirm, as described in the [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html).
```
